proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _ I hI
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hprod⟩ := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_prime_factors I hI
  refine ⟨s, fun p hp => ⟨Ideal.isPrime_of_prime (hs p hp), (hs p hp).ne_zero⟩, associated_iff_eq.mp hprod, ?_⟩
  intro t ht hprodt
  have ht' : ∀ p ∈ t, Prime p := fun p hp => Ideal.prime_of_isPrime (ht p hp).2 (ht p hp).1
  have hrel := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.factors_unique (fun p hp => (ht' p hp).irreducible) (fun p hp => (hs p hp).irreducible) (by rw [hprodt]; exact hprod.symm)
  rw [associated_eq_eq, Multiset.rel_eq] at hrel
  exact hrel
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDedekindDomain A] (I : Ideal A), I ≠ ⊥ → ∃ s : Multiset (Ideal A), (∀ p ∈ s, p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥) ∧ s.prod = I ∧ ∀ t : Multiset (Ideal A), (∀ p ∈ t, p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥) → t.prod = I → t = s
